slides.title: A month on, Moyale clashes continue
Talks have failed, official says
slides.body: A security official told Al Jazeera clashes between forces linked to the Oromia and Somali regions are continuing and mediation attempts have failed.

slides.title: Gunfire at night, closed shops
slides.body: A resident said people remain fearful. Movement is restricted, and businesses, herders and transport operators are hit.
